What these fixtures are based on. None of OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, SuperSlicer or QIDISlicer
was installed where they were written; the files follow the programs' source code, not recorded output.
Moves in the G-code are synthetic (a 20 mm square, 3 layers). Comment lines and folder layouts are as the
programs write them, per these source files:

OrcaSlicer (github.com/SoftFever/OrcaSlicer, main, 2026-11):
  src/libslic3r/GCode.cpp           "; HEADER_BLOCK_START", "; generated by %s on %s", "; max_z_height: %.2f",
                                    filament stats "; filament used [mm|cm3|g] = ", and for non Bambu Lab printers
                                    "; total filament used [g] = %.2lf", "; total layers count = %i"; layer change
                                    writes "; Z_HEIGHT: %g" (Bambu Lab printer) or ";Z:%g" (others)
  src/libslic3r/GCode/GCodeProcessor.cpp
                                    Reserved_Tags (" FEATURE: ", " CHANGE_LAYER") and Reserved_Tags_compatible
                                    ("TYPE:", "LAYER_CHANGE"); "; total layer number: %u"; time line
                                    "; model printing time: %s; total estimated time: %s" (Bambu Lab printer) or
                                    "; estimated printing time (normal mode) = %s" (others)
  src/libslic3r/ExtrusionEntity.cpp role_to_string: "Outer wall", "Inner wall", "Sparse infill", ...
  src/libslic3r/AppConfig.cpp       OrcaSlicer.conf: JSON, "presets": {"machine", "process", "filaments": [...]}
  src/libslic3r/Preset.cpp          presets in system/<vendor>/<kind>/ and .../<kind>/base/, user/<id>/<kind>/
  src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp     CLI: --load-settings, --load-filaments, --slice, --export-3mf, --outputdir,
                                    --arrange, --debug; src/OrcaSlicer.cpp: output "plate_<n>.gcode", help
                                    banner "OrcaSlicer-<version>:"

PrusaSlicer (github.com/prusa3d/PrusaSlicer, tag version_2.9.7):
  src/libslic3r/utils.cpp           header_slic3r_generated: "generated by PrusaSlicer <ver> on <utc>"
  src/libslic3r/GCode.cpp           ";Z:", stats then "; prusaslicer_config = begin ... end" (text G-code only;
                                    binary_gcode = 1 writes .bgcode, so FORM sets binary_gcode = 0)
  src/libslic3r/Print.cpp           "; filament used [g] =", "; total filament used [g] = %.2lf\n"
  src/libslic3r/GCode/GCodeProcessor.cpp
                                    "TYPE:", "LAYER_CHANGE", "HEIGHT:"; "; estimated printing time (%s mode) = %s"
  src/libslic3r/Utils.hpp           get_time_dhms: "%dd %dh %dm %ds" / "%dh %dm %ds" / "%dm %ds" / "%ds"
  src/libslic3r/ExtrusionRole.cpp   "External perimeter", "Perimeter", "Internal infill", "Solid infill", ...
  src/libslic3r/AppConfig.cpp       PrusaSlicer.ini, [presets] print / filament / printer
  src/libslic3r/PresetBundle.cpp    vendor/*.ini bundles, [print:Name] sections, flatten_configbundle_hierarchy
                                    (inherits = a;b, later parents win, *abstract* presets), user presets in
                                    print/, filament/, printer/
  src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp     CLI: --export-gcode, --export-3mf, --load, --output, --datadir
  src/CLI/PrintHelp.cpp             help banner "PrusaSlicer-<build id> based on Slic3r"
